title: Slovakian Beef Fondue
description: A hearty and comforting Slovakian-inspired beef fondue dish, perfect for a German dinner. This recipe brings together rich beef broth and tender beef strips, served with a side of crusty bread for dipping.
instructions: Melt the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the flour and whisk until smooth to make a roux, cooking for 1-2 minutes.
Slowly add the fondue broth, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until thickened.
Slice the beef into thin strips and season with salt and pepper.
Cook the beef in the fondue broth for 2-3 minutes, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Serve the beef with the fondue broth and a side of crusty bread for dipping.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
Optional: Add garlic to the fondue broth for extra flavor.
